digest.component_or_area: code-review extension seam and project-criteria integration
propositions: The code-review extension seam does not dynamically fan-in activated project criteria into Pass 1 discovery phase execution
Project routing can describe criteria but eval/CLI resolution is plan-review-biased and does not map logical project ids to physical validator-safe ids consistently across passes
Pass 3 routing does not consume a repository-effective view of criteria thresholds, posture, and nit-suppression values for project-scoped criteria
Phase-boundary enforcement requires a single co-located project criterion rather than per-phase criteria to preserve architectural separation and make rubric changes auditable rather than hidden
The generic integration seam repair must be delivered before project.review-phase-boundaries authoring and live Gerrit dogfooding can proceed
The pilot must remain advisory-only with blocking_enabled set to false until separate ticket backed by accumulated evidence supports promotion to blocking
